summary: community.dns 3.0.0 drops EOL Ansible versions up to ansible-core 2.13. It removes the name alias of prefix in the hetzner_dns_record(s) modules and removes the hosttech_dns_records redirect to hosttech_dns_record_sets.
questions: Can I still use name: in hetzner_dns_record?

answer_card.title: community.dns 3.0.0 removals
answer_card.answer_md:
- No support for Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 or ansible-core 2.11 to 2.13.
- `hetzner_dns_record_set` / `hetzner_dns_record`: the `name` alias of `prefix` was removed. Use `prefix`.
- The `hosttech_dns_records` redirect was removed. Use `hosttech_dns_record_sets`.
